scope: A bounded nonlinear gauge- and internal-G-invariant scalar observable on K1346's principal-series matter carrier; not a source-owned GU observation map or an empirical observable.

observable.boundedness: 0<=O(phi)<1 for every phi and O(phi) tends to 1 as ||phi|| tends to infinity
observable.internal_G_invariance: O(pi(g)phi)=O(phi) for the unitary principal-series action
observable.nontriviality: O(phi)>0 for phi nonzero and D O_phi[phi]>0 for phi nonzero
observable.nonlinearity: O(-phi)=O(phi), so every nonzero value contradicts linear oddness; also O(a phi) is not a O(phi) in general
observable.k1344_relation: K1344 classifies bounded linear scalar functionals; O is bounded and scalar-valued but nonlinear, so it is outside that theorem without selecting a Riesz covector
observable.field_export: a normalized nonnegative spatial weight may average O(phi(x)) to a bounded gauge- and G-invariant scalar field observable

claim_ceiling: A bounded nonzero scalar map can preserve both local U(1) and the full internal principal-series symmetry when the map is nonlinear. This is the exact map-class escape left open by K1344, not a source-owned observed-state map, a physical measurement prescription or empirical GU export.
